reconciler.reason: Reconciled. Both blind labelers found 8 bends with the same patch pairs. They differed only in the B2/B3 extent overrides, by up to 1.2 mm. My own check covered 12 views, x/y sections, corner close-ups and arc-point profiles. Part 45796000 is CONSUMED, not FRESH, so the label goes in the non-sealed dir. It is a real scan (noise and an outer-base dropout), not CAD: an open press-brake tray about 106x100x38 mm, t about 1.97. It has 4 base-to-wall folds and 4 wall-to-outward-top-flange folds, all about 90 deg. The wall corners are butt seams with no arc. Patch 18 is a thickness edge and patch 20 is a dropout island; neither is a bend. The B2 and B3 outer arcs run to the corners with no gap over 2 mm, but patch 2 is missing next to them, so the auto lines stopped short at 57.9 and 88.6 mm. I set their extent_t to mirror the twin folds' auto extents: B1 gives B2 [-45.25, 55.2] and B4 gives B3 [-43.18, 51.18]. Final lines run (under the geometry lock): rc=0, 8 ok, 0 failed, all outer skin and certain. B2 is 100.45 mm and B3 94.36 mm, each with override support 1.0 and no gaps. I opened all close-ups and overview renders: every line sits on its fold apex and runs corner to corner. One iteration was enough.
